title: Blog post predicting that within a decade we will acknowledge non-human intelligence

tellings.quote: i think that we're going to be stay in a decade from now where we acknowledge that we are not the only life forms that are intelligent and super intelligent on this planet

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad predicts that within about ten years, so by around 2032, people will openly accept that humans are not the only intelligent life on Earth. He tells Michels this in 2022, in his own words: "we acknowledge that we are not the only life forms that are intelligent and super intelligent on this planet." He ties the forecast to a piece of his own writing called "Curiosity as a Time Capsule". If he is right, the coming decade would bring an admission that something other than humans, possibly smarter than us, shares the planet.
